deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution to the intended recipient upon governance action enactment
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to reimburse the lost deposit for the Ikigai Info governance action, plus estimated lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury, consisting of a 100,000 ADA lost governance action deposit plus 3,000 ADA for staking rewards at 2% per annum.
The Ikigai Info governance action submitter was unable to recover a 100,000 ADA deposit because a Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action.
The original Ikigai Info governance action was a symbolic action thanking contributors to Cardano governance and expressing hope for the future.
The proposal says there was significant community sentiment that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed.
The proposal says the Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The proposal states there are no costs or expenses associated with the withdrawal beyond the reimbursement itself.
The proposal states there are no circumstances under which the withdrawal might be refunded to the Cardano treasury.
The proposal states the recipient has not previously received funds from the treasury.
The proposal states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal provides an external reference to an AdaStat governance page for the original governance action.

summary: The document requests 103,000 ADA to reimburse an unnamed recipient for an allegedly unrecoverable 100,000 ADA governance action deposit and 3,000 ADA in estimated lost staking rewards, with immediate on-chain delivery and no refund conditions.
